added_resources.description: title-screen footer branding showing the Unburger Mod version
added_resources.runtime_status: RUNTIME CONFIRMED (2026-10-19), reference composition only: the base atlas stored RAW (FileSize == ExtractSize, no CRILAYLA wrapper) carrying the OTF/CFF-rendered footer reached the title screen and displayed the footer in an Eden run. That run used the face recorded as SHA-256 3c32dc0f… with the built-in style (letter_spacing 0.0). The face and style now shipped (unburger.otf SHA-256 cf1e64aa…, title_footer.toml letter_spacing 0.2) have not been run in the game, so a build of that shipped composition reports RUNTIME UNVERIFIED. Historical, kept accurate: the earlier CRILAYLA-compressed builds FAILED at the title transition with a black screen, a build without the member booted to the menu, and a single-variable RAW build with the ORIGINAL footer reached the menu; the loader rule the RAW storage avoids is NOT proven. The face and style are read live from patcher/assets/fonts (title_footer.toml). Every build compares their digests with the recorded reference and reports whether it is the reference composition, the shipped composition, or a user-modified one; the comparison is never silently assumed to pass. Included in normal builds; set title_branding=false to withhold it.
